d: Anant Singh ki chhoti beti Shivangi Singh ki shadi ko lekar taiyariyan joron par hain. khabar hai ki shadi men hone vale damad Rishikesh Kumar ko karib 3.5 karor rupye ki Defender kar gipht ki jaegi. vahin, chhote bete Abhinav Singh ke lie bhi BMW kar mangaee gaee hai. 25 navanbar ko shivangi ki shadi ke sath hi abhinav ka janeoo sanskar bhi hoga. aakhir kaisi hain anant sinh ke parivar ki shadi ki taiyariyan aur kaun-kaun se khas intjam kie ja rahe hain? dekhie puri riport.
